QUESTION

STATUS

Destination evidence covers 96 M0 ingestion acknowledgments and 94 verified M0 matches; only 93 matches establish current revisions. Current verification gaps are K95, K96, K97, and K12 revision 2.

EVIDENCE
H02–H03: M0 contains K1–K96 revision 1; backup-east and archive-copy alias one stored object, object-amber, not independent copies. H04–H07: ingestion accepted writing; audits matched K1–K94 revision 1, with K95–K96 unaudited and zero observed mismatches. H08–H09: the complete delta ledger contains K97 revision 1 and K12 revision 2; neither has destination ingestion or verification evidence. H10: preview routing neither retired the source nor added verification; its sample excluded all four gaps. H11–H12: planned work remains unexecuted, with no further recorded source changes. Missing audits do not establish corruption.

NEXT
Complete K95–K96 revision-1 comparisons, then synchronize and verify both deltas. If those two comparisons match, M0 becomes fully verified: 96 snapshot matches, but only 95 current matches out of 97; retirement still fails. Retirement requires verified destination matches for every current key/revision, accounting for subsequent writes. Recover exact scope from H01–H03, audit evidence H04–H07, deltas H08–H09, and proposal/cutoff H11–H12.
